slides.title: Logical Operators Overview
slides.prompt: Logical operators combines boolean values: && (AND), || (OR), and ! (NOT).
slides.codeSnippet:
bool a = true, b = false;
bool r1 = a && b; // false
bool r2 = a || b; // true
bool r3 = !a;     // false

slides.title: Logical OR Behavior
slides.prompt: When does the Logical OR (||) operator evaluate to true?
options: If AT LEAST ONE condition is true
Only when both conditions are true
Only when both conditions are false
slides.correctAnswer: If AT LEAST ONE condition is true

slides.title: Logical NOT Function
slides.prompt: What does the Logical NOT (!) operator do?
options: Inverts true to false and false to true
slides.correctAnswer: Inverts true to false and false to true
